title: R1-5 PartCATSeg cross-dataset reproduction protocol draft

references.supports: Pred-All uses no object masks or object class labels; Oracle-Obj does.
Native output is semantic segmentation and does not distinguish repeated same-part instances.
Official VOC, ADE, PartImageNet checkpoint links; canonical evaluation example uses VOC.

cohort.input: All 42 archived r5 source_crop.png inputs. Anonymous paths and SHA256 supplied to inference; case/category/reference mapping retained only by evaluator. Identical annotation-derived crop context to historical HPID baseline.
cohort.scope: Retrospective comparison on existing holdout; no fresh untouched-cohort claim. Object crops are a shared localization aid, not full-image discovery. No exclusion based on outputs, native-vocabulary coverage, object category, success or score.
cohort.category_information: Historical42CLI and source audit confirmed no true object category/profile was passed to HPID. Both primary methods receive the same already-localized image pixels; both must infer category/part class.

checkpoint.rationale: Canonical released README evaluation recipe, chosen before target inference or scoring, not a claim that VOC is optimal for PACO. ADE and PartImageNet are alternative released trained models, not to be tried and selected by target outcome.
checkpoint.other_models: Only if prospectively added, report all variants as secondary. CAT-Seg model_final_base.pth is a training initializer, not the trained PartCATSeg comparator.
checkpoint.receipt: Record actual checkpoint SHA256 and any missing/unexpected state_dict keys before starting the cohort.

vocabulary.selection: All public object-part categories containing colon, sorted by numeric PACO category id. No annotation rows or current 42-case present-part lists are used.
vocabulary.labels: 0..455 correspond registry order; background=456. Store uint16 PNG/TIFF or integer NPY; ignore=65535 is distinct.
vocabulary.object_names: All 75 public object names, global for every input.
vocabulary.text_rule: Convert object:part to object-with-underscores-as-spaces + apostrophe-s + part-with-underscores-as-spaces. Preserve remaining spelling, including parenthetical qualifiers; no outcome-dependent synonyms or prompt selection. Record raw and rendered names in registry.
vocabulary.metadata: Register test stuff_classes/object classes before building model, set test metadata ignore_label=65535. Retain original VOC training metadata/config and learned parameters. Official ImageNet prompt templates unchanged.
vocabulary.technical_reason_ignore: Both model and predictor allocate text_to_part_map of length ignore_label+1; 255 cannot accommodate 456 indexed classes. ADE already uses 65535.
vocabulary.alternative_preexisting_scope: Released HPID broad 67-object catalog still has 432 PACO object-part pairs; not a useful memory reduction and unnecessarily narrows candidate vocabulary.

inference_interface.official_behavior: baselines/partcatseg.py lines216-217 reads obj_part_sem_seg and sem_seg even during eval. Inference lines344-356 uses instances.gt_classes solely to filter the sem_seg output. sem_seg_all is generated before that filtering, includes background and does not depend on the supplied GT labels.
inference_interface.primary_output: Only official sem_seg_all, argmax across all 456 part channels and background after official sem_seg_postprocess at original crop size. No category restriction, GT object-mask gating, target-conditioned candidate list, confidence threshold, morphology or pixel cleanup.
inference_interface.allowed_api_scaffolding: Constant data-independent dummy object/part tensors and a constant dummy gt_classes value solely to satisfy forward API. Do not read real annotations in model process. Use eval and inference_mode.
inference_interface.preprocessing: Original deterministic test ResizeShortestEdge/min-size 640/max-size 768, RGB, original normalization and CLIP/DINO sizes; original ImageList and postprocess. Verify actual inherited config before freeze.
controls: Smoke on official VOC116 metadata without evaluating PACO results.
For the same non-scoring image, change dummy GT maps and dummy object class; sem_seg_all must remain identical.
Validate image dimensions, all logits finite, registry order, background handling and output bounds.
inference_interface.execution: One successful attempt per image; infrastructure recovery recorded with same frozen settings, never choose a better-scoring retry. No labels/cases omitted after results.

resource_policy.memory: Full456 vocabulary and official decoder can exceed 6GB in float32. A 457-channel float32 CPU score map at768x768 alone occupies 1,078,198,272 bytes. Check resource feasibility without scoring before final freeze.
resource_policy.forbidden: Do not split full model into separate label-vocabulary forward passes and concatenate: aggregation includes cross-class attention. Do not shrink vocabulary after inspecting accuracy.
resource_policy.allowed_if_documented: CPU execution or exact device offload. Independent decoder-class batching may be considered only after numerical parity verification on VOC full decoding, without changing cross-class aggregation. Mixed precision changes arithmetic and must be recorded and frozen, never selected by score.

primary_endpoint.name: Macro geometric Part F1 at IoU0.25 across all42
primary_endpoint.conversion: For each non-background raw semantic label independently, find every 8-connected component at native output resolution. Each nonempty component is one predicted part; no area filtering. Use canonical row-major component order only for reproducibility.
primary_endpoint.matching: Same frozen HPID evaluator Hungarian maximum total mask-IoU, then threshold, same archived cropped references and root-body inclusion rule. All predicted components enter counts, including wrong-object classes and unmapped semantics. No GT-based clipping/reselection.
primary_endpoint.interpretation: PartCATSeg plus deterministic instance adapter versus native HPID Parts. This is not native PartCATSeg instance segmentation or a claim of universal algorithm superiority.

geometry: prediction count and valid output rate
secondary_endpoints.semantic: Use union of all pixels of each predicted semantic (without connected-component conversion), the frozen PACO-to-HPID canonical alias bridge, and union of corresponding reference masks. Score both methods by the same fixed mapping and full crop coordinates. Report annotation-conditioned semantic-union IoU and semantic precision/recall; explicitly not official Pascal/ADE/PartImageNet mIoU. Preserve raw native PartCATSeg label maps for audit.
secondary_endpoints.mapping_caution: HPID domain-level names cannot be inverted uniquely to all456 object-specific PACO labels. Do not invent an inverse using GT. For PartCATSeg derive mapping from its predicted category name and public catalog domain; a wrong object/domain must not be repaired with target GT. Unmapped predictions still count in geometric primary and are separately reported.
secondary_endpoints.partial_annotations: Before freezing exact semantic formula, audit overlapping/unknown reference regions. Unannotated target pixels cannot silently become dense background; avoid forcing overlapping part masks into a single arbitrary semantic label. The existing semantic-union metric can handle overlapping reference masks. Report eligible reference-class coverage.
non_endpoints: Persistent-ID export should be reported as a contract/capability distinction, not an accuracy score assigning unsupported methods zero.
Do not create HPID-like Groups for PartCATSeg with GT-aware grouping.
Do not claim official base/novel hIoU on PACO without a valid prospectively fixed split.

statistics.unit: Paired source image/target,42 unique source images verified in existing manifest
statistics.primary_CI: Paired percentile95% CI for mean per-case HPID minus PartCATSeg PartF1@0.25; report both means and difference.
statistics.secondary_CI: Descriptive pointwise only unless multiplicity scheme predeclared. For pooled confusion-based mIoU resample images and sum confusion before computing, do not confuse it with mean per-case IoU.
statistics.failures: Keep all42. Missing/invalid output has zero primary and comparative semantic success. Report failure flags/counts and all-case denominators.
statistics.reporting: Report observed result in either direction. Do not select cohort, checkpoint, threshold, component rule, ontology or endpoint based on which method wins.

decoder_equivalence.scope: One VOC smoke image on the recorded device; not a universal proof

numeric_execution_policy.reason: Validate decoder batching under fixed full-float32 arithmetic

executed_numerical_controls.limits: Synthetic fixture controls execution, memory and numerical consistency only; no accuracy data.

final_execution.arithmetic: float32 learned layers; TF32/autocast disabled; fixed cuDNN policy
final_execution.precision_note: Vendored official CLIP text encoder construction retains its official pretrained dtype.
